heading: Where they went
intro: Two waves of Greeks leaving home. A simple sketch of where they went, not to scale.

waves.note: Almost a sixth of Greece's population emigrated, mostly to the United States and Egypt.
More than one million Greeks emigrated in this second wave, most to Western Europe, the United States, Canada and Australia. Between 1974 and 1985 almost half of them returned to Greece.

source.text: Migration Policy Institute, Greece: A History of Migration (Kasimis and Kassimi, 2004)
